Inputs from juice's own test suite, `test/cases` at
[v12.1.3](https://github.com/Automattic/juice/tree/v12.1.3/test/cases).
Expected outputs are regenerated by the oracle like every other fixture;
upstream `.out` files are not copied.

- `inline-content/`: `inlineContent(html, css, options)` cases. The `.css`
  file becomes the `extraCss` option.
- `juice-content/`: `juiceResources` cases. `url` is dropped, since fetching
  resources is out of scope; `<link>` tags pass through untouched.
- `cli/`: per-call `codeBlocks` become client `codeBlocks`, which is how plain
  `juice()` reads them.
